title: Your First Weekend at Colorado School of Mines, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check In at the Gateway
cards.subtitle: 1812 Illinois St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: Start your journey at this modern hub for admissions and alumni. It serves as the official entry point for new Orediggers and their families during move-in weekend.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome center and starting point for new students at Colorado School of Mines.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starzer Welcome Center is the home for the Office of Admissions and serves as a primary campus tour and welcome starting point.
cards.source_title: From Stratton Hall to Starzer Welcome Center
cards.access_notes: Open during standard business hours; extended hours often apply during orientation weekends.

cards.title: Attend University Convocation
cards.subtitle: Inside the Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Gather with your entire class for the official welcome ceremony. This formal induction marks the beginning of your academic career at Mines.
cards.short_summary: The venue for the official Mines welcome ceremony for all new students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation is the official Mines welcome ceremony held in Lockridge Arena inside the Student Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Helluva Welcome - New Student and Transition Services
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for guests; students do not need tickets for this specific event.

cards.title: Join the Welcome BBQ
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Green Space
cards.notes: Head to the campus green for a community meal after convocation. It is a prime spot to meet fellow first-years and their families in a relaxed setting.
cards.short_summary: A central campus lawn used for major student gatherings, including the annual Welcome BBQ.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Student & Family Welcome BBQ is held at Kafadar Commons following the convocation ceremony.
cards.source_title: New Student & Family Welcome BBQ - Mines Events
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their families during orientation; typically held in the early evening.

cards.title: Participate in the M Climb
cards.subtitle: Hike to the Iconic 'M'
cards.notes: Carry a 10-pound rock from your hometown up Mount Zion to help whitewash the 'M'. This century-old tradition is a rite of passage for every Oredigger.
cards.short_summary: A signature Mines tradition where freshmen hike Mount Zion to maintain the university's hillside emblem.
cards.evidence_claim: The M Climb is a symbolic initiation where students carry a 10-pound rock from their hometown to place on the 'M' on Mount Zion.
cards.source_title: The History of the M Climb
cards.access_notes: The climb is a scheduled orientation event; the trail itself is open from sunrise to sundown.

cards.title: Explore the Geology Museum
cards.subtitle: 1310 Maple St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: See moon rocks and glowing minerals at one of the top earth science museums in the country. It is a quiet, fascinating way to spend a weekend afternoon.
cards.short_summary: A world-class geology museum on campus featuring minerals, fossils, and gemstones.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mines Museum of Earth Science offers free admission and is open daily from 10 AM to 4 PM.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free for all visitors; open daily 10am-4pm.

cards.title: Visit the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: 1651 Elm St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: Check out the climbing wall or the elevated jogging track. It is the primary hub for fitness and intramural sports on campus.
cards.short_summary: The main campus facility for fitness, swimming, and indoor recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Recreation Center features a 4,000 sq. ft. climbing wall and an elevated jogging track.
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 9am-7pm during the fall semester.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: 1400 Illinois St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: Scout out the best quiet corners or collaborative rooms before classes start. The library is the intellectual heart of the Mines campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic library at Mines, offering diverse study environments and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Arthur Lakes Library provides reservable study rooms and is open on Saturdays from 10 AM to 5 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays 10am-5pm; closed on Sundays during summer/orientation transitions.

cards.title: Explore CoorsTek Center
cards.subtitle: 1523 Illinois St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: Walk through this high-tech building to find open-concept study areas with great views. It is designed to mimic a modern professional engineering environment.
cards.short_summary: A modern academic building known for its collaborative workspaces and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The CoorsTek Center features open environments and up-to-date technology for group projects and individual study.
cards.access_notes: Generally accessible to students with a BlasterCard; open areas are available during building hours.

cards.title: Grab a Meal at Mines Market
cards.subtitle: 1795 Elm St, Golden, CO 80401
cards.notes: Experience the main dining hall's various stations. It is the primary social and nutritional hub for residential students on the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: The central residential dining facility at Colorado School of Mines.
cards.evidence_claim: Mines Market is the primary dining location on campus, located at 1795 Elm Street.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; hours vary by meal period.

cards.title: Walk the Clear Creek Trail
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Campus
cards.notes: Take a break from campus and walk along the creek that runs through Golden. It is a popular spot for students to relax and enjoy the Colorado outdoors.
cards.short_summary: A scenic paved trail following Clear Creek, located just steps from the Mines campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clear Creek Trail is a popular recreational path in Golden used by students for walking and biking.
cards.access_notes: Public trail open daily from dawn to dusk.
